description: Define fixtures in the test file, not separate conftest.py. Truly reusable fixtures (file ops, location helpers) go in base conftest.py. Example: @pytest.fixture def workspace_root(tmp_path): return tmp_path / 'workspace'

do.description: Define fixtures in same test file. Example: @pytest.fixture def config_file(tmp_path): ... (in test_agent.py)

guidance.description: Define fixtures in the test file that uses them
Fixtures can depend on other fixtures
Truly reusable fixtures go in base conftest.py
example: # In agents/base/src/conftest.py (for reuse across all tests)

dont.description: Don't create separate conftest.py for agent-specific fixtures. Example: src/conftest.py with agent fixtures (wrong - put in test file)

guidance.description: Don't create conftest.py for single-test-file fixtures
example: # WRONG: src/conftest.py with fixtures only used by one test file

guidance.description: Don't put agent-specific fixtures in shared conftest
example: # WRONG: Base conftest with StoryBot-specific fixtures
